## What changed?

Describe the change clearly and concisely.

## Why?

Explain the problem being solved or the improvement being made.

## How was it tested?

Describe the validation performed. Include the DBeaver version when relevant.

- [ ] Validation workflow passes
- [ ] Built locally when the change affects packaging/installation

## Checklist

- [ ] Generated `build/` and `dist/` files are not committed
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`
